metadata.scenario: Someone inquires about the qualifications of the new therapists recently hired. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Thomas White. I got your number from a support group recommendation. Nice to meet you, Thomas! What can I assist you with today? I’m looking for specialized dementia care for my mother, who has Alzheimer's. We can definitely help with that. Do you have any specific questions about our services? Yes, I heard you recently hired new therapists. Can you tell me about their qualifications? Of course! Our new therapists are highly trained and have experience in dementia and Alzheimer's care. That’s good to hear. How do they handle specialized care for clients? They implement personalized care plans tailored to each client’s needs, focusing on safety and engagement. Oh, that sounds reassuring. What kind of training do they have in dementia care specifically? They undergo ongoing education in dementia care strategies, including communication techniques and activity planning. That’s great. I’m also interested in respite services for myself. Can you provide information on that? Certainly! Our respite care is designed to give family caregivers a break, and it’s $30 to $38 per hour. Would it be possible to schedule an assessment for my mother? Absolutely! I can connect you with our Care Coordinator for that. Would you like to provide your contact details? Sure, my phone number is +13165558962. Thank you, Thomas. I’ll have Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, reach out to you shortly. That sounds good. How soon can I expect to hear from her? She usually responds within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Thomas! Have a great day. You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
